summary: Tested CalendarSyncAlert (red bar) feature end-to-end. Backend GET /api/calendar/health validated across 4 states (default, broken/invalid_grant, creds-dropped, healthy) + 401 unauth. Frontend verified alert visibility rules, navigation to /settings, 4h sessionStorage dismissal persistence, cross-page visibility, new-context behavior, and healthy-state hiding. All checks pass. Mongo seed cleanup confirmed (both docs removed).
critical_code_review_comments: CalendarSyncAlert.wasUsed only checks has_credentials || last_sync || last_pull_at. If credentials are dropped after an invalid_grant BEFORE any pull/sync was ever recorded (unlikely but possible), the alert would silently not render even though last_error/last_error_at are present. Consider adding `|| status.last_error_at` to wasUsed so the alert never regresses to silent in that edge case.
GET /api/calendar/health is open to any authenticated user (any role). If this is intended admin-only (sync setup is admin-only), add role check; otherwise OK as a read-only health field.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted settings docs google_calendar + google_calendar_sync via mongosh/pymongo for state simulation; both removed at end. Confirmed via Mongo query returning [].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health alert flows all verified. Backend test file test_calendar_health_alert.py covers default/broken/dropped/healthy + auth gate and auto-cleans.
